summary: A standalone static marketing website for the r450k platform has been added at r450k/ in the repository root. The site is built with React 18 + Vite and deployed automatically to Cloudflare Pages (production branch: main, root dir: r450k, build output: dist) at https://r450k.com. It is a single-page landing covering the platform's features, how-it-works, hardware tiers, showcase (tabbed animated mockups), use cases, and the three platform apps (mymatasan, myseliasan, myidsan). All site copy lives in r450k/src/content.js for easy edits without touching layout. Premium UX animations (aurora background, scroll-reveal, cursor spotlight, 3D-tilt cards, magnetic buttons, scroll progress bar) are included, all guarded by prefers-reduced-motion. A floating contact widget offers a one-tap Telegram deep link and a message form that posts to a Cloudflare Pages Function at r450k/functions/api/contact.js, which relays to Telegram via the Bot API; secrets (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) are Cloudflare Pages environment variables and are never stored in the repository. The site is wired to https://r450k.com with canonical/OG tags, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and og-image.svg. This is entirely decoupled from the Go backend; it has no effect on infra/versioning/version.json app versions.
compatibility: No impact on existing installs. The r450k/ directory is a separate Node project; the Go build, Docker image, and backend runtime are completely unaffected. The Cloudflare Pages build runs independently of the GitHub Actions version-manifest workflow.
